A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] '''safehouse''' existed on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[New Nystao]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. During a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Raid on Wayland (25 ABY)|raid]], the safehouse was attacked by an [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong assassin (Wayland)|assassin]].
